describe.description: The image shows a single large, quadrupedal, cat-like mammal standing in profile facing to the right with its head turned slightly toward the viewer. The body is robust and muscular, covered in short tawny light-brown fur that is paler on the chest, belly and around the muzzle, with faint dark striping across the back, sides and limbs. The neck and chest have longer, shaggy fur forming a ruff. The head is broad with a short muzzle, a pinkish-brown nose, white fur on the chin and lower jaw, visible whiskers, and dark eyes. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in large paws, and a short tail with a dark tip extends behind the hindquarters. The background is plain off-white with a soft shadow under the feet.

describe.description: A large, powerfully built four-legged feline shown standing in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. It has a tawny golden-brown coat with pale cream on the lower chest, belly, lower legs and muzzle, faint dark vertical striping over the back, sides and belly and bolder dark striping on the lower legs and tail, a broad short-muzzled lion-like face with no full mane but slightly longer fur around the neck and chest, small rounded ears, and a muscular barrel body carried on four thick legs ending in large paws, with a short thin tail with a dark tip extending behind the hindquarters.
